_meta.description: Complete citation registry for all clinical formulas and datasets used in VitalTwin
_meta.format: Each entry: { doi, authors, title, journal, year, sample_size, population, formula_used, organ_model, confidence_note }

pooled_cohort_equations.title: 2013 ACC/AHA Guideline on the Assessment of Cardiovascular Risk
pooled_cohort_equations.population: US adults, externally validated in multiple countries
pooled_cohort_equations.formula_used: Pooled Cohort Equations (PCE) — primary 10yr ASCVD risk engine
pooled_cohort_equations.confidence_note: Gold standard for CVD risk; external validation C-statistic ~0.71-0.78

south_asian_correction.title: Prediction of cardiovascular risk in England and Wales: prospective derivation and validation of QRISK2
south_asian_correction.population: UK including South Asian ethnicity subgroup
south_asian_correction.formula_used: South Asian ethnicity multiplier ×1.26 applied to PCE base risk
south_asian_correction.confidence_note: South Asian multiplier validated in SABRE cohort and QRISK2

framingham_point_score.title: Prediction of Coronary Heart Disease Using Risk Factor Categories
framingham_point_score.formula_used: Framingham point score — used as fallback when PCE inputs incomplete
framingham_point_score.confidence_note: Fallback method; slight overestimation in non-US populations

nfhs5_district_priors.title: National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) 2019-21
nfhs5_district_priors.formula_used: District-level hypertension/diabetes prevalence priors for risk adjustment
nfhs5_district_priors.confidence_note: Official Government of India data; hypertension: 21% men, 24% women

caide_dementia_score.title: Risk score for the prediction of dementia risk in 20 years
caide_dementia_score.formula_used: CAIDE Dementia Risk Score — primary dementia risk (20-yr horizon)
caide_dementia_score.confidence_note: CAIDE C-statistic 0.77; validated in multiple European cohorts

interstroke_india.title: Global and regional effects of potentially modifiable risk factors associated with acute stroke in 32 countries
interstroke_india.sample_size: 26,919 cases and controls in 32 countries; India: 3,000+ cases from 10 hospitals
interstroke_india.population: South Asia subgroup — India, Pakistan, Bangladesh (Table 3)
interstroke_india.formula_used: 10 modifiable risk factors with India-specific adjusted ORs and PAR% — replaces European stroke ML
interstroke_india.confidence_note: 10 factors explain 91.5% of stroke PAR in South Asia. Highest quality stroke data for Indian population.

india_stroke_baseline.authors: GBD 2016 Neurology Collaborators (Feigin VL et al.)
india_stroke_baseline.title: Global, regional, and national burden of neurological disorders, 1990–2016
india_stroke_baseline.sample_size: Global Burden of Disease study — India-specific incidence rates
india_stroke_baseline.formula_used: India age-specific baseline 10-year stroke probabilities by age group
india_stroke_baseline.confidence_note: GBD 2016 India stroke incidence used for absolute risk calibration

framingham_stroke.title: Stroke risk profile: adjustment for antihypertensive medication
framingham_stroke.formula_used: Framingham Stroke Risk Profile — calibration check (10% weight)
framingham_stroke.confidence_note: Used as BP-driven secondary calibration signal only

fib4_index.title: Development of a simple noninvasive index to predict significant fibrosis in patients with HIV/HCV coinfection
fib4_index.population: HIV/HCV coinfection; validated across multiple liver disease etiologies
fib4_index.confidence_note: EASL-recommended non-invasive fibrosis marker; validated across NAFLD, viral hepatitis

nafld_lfs.title: The Fatty Liver Index: a simple and accurate predictor of hepatic steatosis in the general population
nafld_lfs.formula_used: NAFLD Liver Fat Score — detects fatty liver without imaging (sensitivity 85%, specificity 71%)
nafld_lfs.confidence_note: LFS>-0.64 indicates fatty liver likely; used when no FIB-4 lab data

ilpd_indian_dataset.authors: Ramana CV et al.; Bais B et al.
ilpd_indian_dataset.title: ILPD (Indian Liver Patient Dataset) — UCI Machine Learning Repository
ilpd_indian_dataset.population: Indian patients, Andhra Pradesh (North-East AP region)
ilpd_indian_dataset.formula_used: GradientBoosting model (AUC 0.750) — 40% weight in liver ensemble
ilpd_indian_dataset.confidence_note: Only Indian-population liver ML dataset available open-source. Captures India-specific enzyme patterns.

lean_nafld_india.title: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in India — a lot done, yet more required!
lean_nafld_india.journal: Journal of Clinical and Experimental Hepatology. 2015;5(Suppl 1):S9-S16
lean_nafld_india.formula_used: India-specific rule: BMI<23 + ALT>40 → lean NAFLD elevated risk flag (+0.12)
lean_nafld_india.confidence_note: ~25% of Indian NAFLD occurs at BMI<23. Critical India-specific rule missed by standard BMI-based screening.

ckd_epi_2021.title: New Creatinine- and Cystatin C–Based Equations to Estimate GFR without Race
ckd_epi_2021.sample_size: >10,000 patients across multiple external validation cohorts
ckd_epi_2021.formula_used: CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine equation — eGFR calculation for kidney function staging
ckd_epi_2021.confidence_note: Current KDIGO-recommended eGFR equation; removes race coefficient

kdoqi_ckd_staging.title: KDIGO 2012 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of Chronic Kidney Disease
kdoqi_ckd_staging.formula_used: CKD staging G1-G5 by eGFR thresholds (G1≥90, G2 60-89, G3a 45-59, G3b 30-44, G4 15-29, G5<15)
kdoqi_ckd_staging.confidence_note: International clinical standard for CKD staging and management

apollo_indian_kidney.title: Chronic Kidney Disease Dataset — UCI ML Repository
apollo_indian_kidney.formula_used: Random Forest ML model (AUC 0.97) — primary kidney ML signal
apollo_indian_kidney.confidence_note: Indian hospital data. AUC 0.97 on internal validation. Highest quality available kidney data for India.

gold_2023_copd.authors: Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease (GOLD)
gold_2023_copd.title: Global Strategy for Prevention, Diagnosis and Management of COPD — 2023 Report
gold_2023_copd.sample_size: Evidence synthesis from hundreds of trials
gold_2023_copd.formula_used: FEV1/FVC <0.70 threshold; FEV1% predicted GOLD staging; pack-year thresholds (10/20/40)
gold_2023_copd.confidence_note: International clinical standard for COPD diagnosis and staging

balakrishnan_indoor_air.title: The impact of air pollution on deaths, disease burden, and life expectancy across the states of India
balakrishnan_indoor_air.sample_size: State-level analysis across all Indian states — GBD India 2017
balakrishnan_indoor_air.population: India — household air pollution from solid fuels
balakrishnan_indoor_air.formula_used: Biomass cooking fuel risk: +0.22 risk increment (wood/crop residue), +0.25 (dung/coal)
balakrishnan_indoor_air.confidence_note: Lancet series on India state-level disease burden. HAP from biomass = significant COPD driver.

tb_lung_sequelae.title: Respiratory complications of untreated and treated pulmonary tuberculosis
tb_lung_sequelae.journal: International Journal of Tuberculosis and Lung Disease. 2013;17(4):429-438
tb_lung_sequelae.population: TB survivors (high TB burden countries including India)
tb_lung_sequelae.formula_used: Post-TB obstructive/restrictive pattern risk: active TB +0.40, treated TB +0.20
tb_lung_sequelae.confidence_note: ~40% of TB survivors develop obstructive defects; India has world's highest TB burden

cpcb_aqi_2023.authors: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), Government of India
cpcb_aqi_2023.title: Annual Air Quality Report 2023
cpcb_aqi_2023.journal: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
cpcb_aqi_2023.sample_size: Annual average PM2.5 from 150+ Indian cities
cpcb_aqi_2023.formula_used: City PM2.5 lookup table; each 10 µg/m³ above 10 = +5% COPD risk (GBD 2019)
cpcb_aqi_2023.confidence_note: Official India government PM2.5 data. Delhi: 98.6 µg/m³ (19.7× WHO limit).

klemera_doubal_kdm.title: A new approach to the concept and computation of biological age
klemera_doubal_kdm.formula_used: KDM formula: BA = Σ(k_j·(x_j-q_j)/s_j²) / Σ(k_j²/s_j²) with Bayesian CA blend
klemera_doubal_kdm.confidence_note: Best-performing biological age method in head-to-head comparisons (Levine 2013)

levine_nhanes_validation.title: Modeling the rate of senescence: Can estimated biological age predict mortality more accurately than chronological age?
levine_nhanes_validation.formula_used: KDM biomarker regression parameters (NHANES-calibrated slopes and reference values)
levine_nhanes_validation.confidence_note: KDM outperforms other aging measures for mortality prediction (HR 1.22 per 5yr bio-age increase)

south_asian_offset.title: The relationship between metabolic risk factors and incident cardiovascular disease in Europeans, South Asians, and African Caribbeans: SABRE
south_asian_offset.population: South Asian migrants to UK (SABRE cohort) — generalizable to Indian subcontinent
south_asian_offset.formula_used: South Asian biological age offset: +1.8 years applied post-KDM calculation
south_asian_offset.confidence_note: South Asians show 1.8yr accelerated metabolic aging vs Europeans at same chronological age

waist_circumference_india.title: Appropriate body-mass index for Asian populations and its implications for policy and intervention strategies
waist_circumference_india.formula_used: Waist circumference KDM biomarker: men ref 85cm, women ref 72cm (India-specific)
waist_circumference_india.confidence_note: India-specific waist cutoffs: men >90cm, women >80cm indicates abdominal obesity

resting_hr_aging.title: Resting heart rate in middle age and diabetes development in older age
resting_hr_aging.sample_size: NHANES study — large US general population cohort
resting_hr_aging.population: US adults (NHANES), generalizable to Indian population
resting_hr_aging.formula_used: Resting HR as KDM biomarker: HR>80 bpm = +2.4yr biological age vs HR<60 (Carnethon 2014)
resting_hr_aging.confidence_note: Resting HR correlates with aerobic fitness decline, cardiovascular aging, and autonomic function

indian_datasets_used.name: NFHS-5
indian_datasets_used.used_for: District-level hypertension/diabetes priors for heart model

indian_datasets_used.name: CPCB Annual AQI 2023
indian_datasets_used.used_for: City PM2.5 lookup for lung model

indian_datasets_used.name: INTERSTROKE India subgroup
indian_datasets_used.used_for: Brain stroke risk formula (replaced European ML)

planned_future_datasets.name: LASI Wave 1
planned_future_datasets.status: Requires free registration — planned for lung and brain model upgrade

planned_future_datasets.name: ICMR-INDIAB 2011
planned_future_datasets.status: Planned for heart/kidney district priors improvement
